arxiv-2206-14760.title: A hybrid level-based learning swarm algorithm with mutation operator for solving large-scale cardinality-constrained portfolio optimization problems
arxiv-2206-14760.creator: Massimiliano Kaucic, Filippo Piccotto, Gabriele Sbaiz, Giorgio Valentinuz
arxiv-2206-14760.description: Abstract In this work, we propose a hybrid variant of the level-based learning swarm optimizer (LLSO) for solving large-scale portfolio optimization problems. Our goal is to maximize a modified formulation of the Sharpe ratio subject to cardinality, box and budget constraints.

arxiv-2209-04087.title: A Variational Approach to Parameter Estimation for Characterizing 2-D Cluster Variation Method Topographies
arxiv-2209-04087.creator: Alianna J. Maren
arxiv-2209-04087.description: Abstract One of the biggest challenges in characterizing 2-D topographies is succinctly communicating the dominant nature of local configurations. In a 2-D grid composed of bistate units, this could be expressed as finding the characteristic configuration variables such as nearest-neighbor pairs and triplet combinations.

arxiv-2403-18428.title: Fermion integrals for finite spectral triples
arxiv-2403-18428.creator: John W. Barrett
arxiv-2403-18428.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by John W. Barrett. Fermion functional integrals are calculated for the Dirac operator of a finite real spectral triple. Complex, real and chiral functional integrals are considered for each KO-dimension where they are non-trivial, and phase ambiguities in the definition are noted. 1
Introduction

Spectral triples provide a precise mathematical framework for the Dirac operator, allowing the generalisation to non-commutative spaces

arxiv-2506-04029.title: Accessing proton number fluctuations in limited regions of phase space
arxiv-2506-04029.creator: Piotr Bożek
arxiv-2506-04029.description: Abstract In heavy ion collisions particle distributions fluctuate from event to event. It is interesting to study local fluctuations of a specific particle specie, e.g. baryons, in the transverse plane. Fluctuations of the harmonic flow provide an integrated measure of such fluctuations. An alternative approach is to study proton number fluctuations measured in a relatively narrow azimuthal angle window.

arxiv-2601-19805.title: Containments of Tensor Network Varieties
arxiv-2601-19805.creator: Sofía Garzón Mora, Christian Haase
arxiv-2601-19805.description: Abstract . Building upon the work of Buczyńska et al. [ BBM15 ] , we study here tensor formats and their corresponding encoding of tensors via two-fold tensor products determined by the combinatorics of a binary tree. The set of all tensors representable by a given network forms the corresponding tensor network variety.

pmc-10542940.title: Deciphering m6A dynamics at a single-base level during planarian anterior-posterior axis specification
pmc-10542940.creator: Liqian Chen, Hui Zhen, Zixin Chen, Mujie Huang, Daniel W Mak, Wei Jin, Yuxiu Zou, Mingjie Chen, Mingyue Zheng, Qingqiang Xie, Zhongjun Zhou, Guoxiang Jin
pmc-10542940.description: BackgroundThe establishment of the anterior-posterior (A-P) axis is a crucial step during tissue repair and regeneration. Despite the association reported recently of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) with regeneration, the mechanism underlying the regulation of m6A in A-P axis specification during regeneration remains unknown.

pmc-11343416.title: Effects of different roughness on Brazilian splitting characteristics of rock-concrete interface
pmc-11343416.creator: Yan Chen, Gaofei Wang, Lei Zhou, Liangtao Deng, Jiahao Wang, Xun Xi, Xun Xi, Xun Xi
pmc-11343416.description: In order to study the tensile properties of rock-concrete composite disc specimens with different roughness, the surface of the gray-white sand specimen was artificially grooved, and six different roughness were configured. The test results show that the roughness size and roughness mode jointly control the tensile strength of the rock-concrete interface.

pmc-11421224.title: The case against stenting the cannulation zone of dialysis access
pmc-11421224.creator: Ivana Boktor, Abduljalil Alragheb, Ahmed E Ali, Ammar Almehmi
pmc-11421224.description: The indications for stent grafts (SG) placement within the dialysis vascular access include recurrent stenosis at the venous anastomosis of arteriovenous grafts, vessel rupture, pseudoaneurysm exclusion, and intra-stent stenosis. Controversy exists regarding the use of SGs within the cannulation zone due to the theoretical risks of increased infection and stent fracture.

pmc-11516355.title: 5.B. Round table: Improving digital health literacy in the era of generative artificial intelligence
pmc-11516355.creator: Organised by: EUPHA-HL, -HP, -DH, -ETH, -FS, -GH, IUHPE Working Group on Health Literacy, Technical University of Munich (Germany), Chair persons: Don Nutbeam (Australia), Orkan Okan (EUPHA-HL)
pmc-11516355.description: Improved access to generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms and technologies has prompted greater awareness of their potential application in health communication. This workshop will examine this potential alongside the practical challenges and risks of using generative AI in health communication in the broader context of the European Union AI Act.

pmc-11638277.title: Literature review of clinical analysis of hereditary neuropathy with liability to pressure palsies
pmc-11638277.creator: Limin Chen, Hongbo Zhang, Chunnv Li, Nuo Yang, Jiangtao Wang, Jianmin Liang
pmc-11638277.description: This review summarizes the clinical and electromyography (EMG) characteristics and peripheral myelin protein 22 (PMP22) gene-related diseases of hereditary neuropathy with liability to pressure palsies (HNPP). Clinical, EMG, and laboratory data of patients diagnosed with HNPP at our institution from 2022 to 2023 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11862052.title: Neuropsychiatric symptoms in frontotemporal dementia: a case report
pmc-11862052.creator: A Izquierdo De La Puente, P del Sol Calderón, R Fernandez Fernandez
pmc-11862052.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionWe present the case of a 70-year-old man who, after presenting atypical depressive symptoms, was diagnosed with incipient frontotemporal dementia.ObjectivesThrough the presentation of the case, a brief review is made of the affective prodromes of frontotemporal dementiaMethods The patient, who had no personal history of interest, suddenly began to present depressive symptoms consisting of marked irritability, dysphoric mood, anxious semiology with a subjective feeling of anguish, maintenance insomnia and a feeling of lack of self-control, with a tendency towards verbal heteroaggressiveness.

pmc-13011049.creator: Leah Foster+
pmc-13011049.description: PICO questionIn hospitalised domestic cats, does the use of hiding boxes compared to no intervention reduce fear and stress?Clinical bottom lineCategory of researchTreatment.Number and type of study designs reviewedFive studies were critically reviewed. pmc-13075292.title: A Novel Contactless Scanning Conductivity-Detection Approach for Moving Reaction Boundary Analysis in Electrophoresis Titration Sensors
pmc-13075292.creator: Haozheng Dai, Youli Tian, Ke-Er Chen, Weiwen Liu, Qiang Zhang, Chengxi Cao
pmc-13075292.description: Electrophoresis titration sensors are widely used for biomarker detection. However, traditional methods rely on a visible boundary for signal readout. Although conventional capacitively coupled contactless conductivity detection avoids indicator dependence, its single-point detection method suffers from long measurement times, large amounts of redundant data, and the inability to dynamically monitor the moving reaction boundary.

pmc-13199936.title: Quantitative dissection of radioresistance in cancer cells: Oxygen depletion-induced biological versus chemical mechanisms and baseline mechanisms governed by HIF-1β-NRF2/TXNRD1
pmc-13199936.creator: Satoshi Takeuchi, Minoru Kobayashi, Peter Wai Tik Lee, Itsuki Takahashi, Toshitada Yoshihara, Hiroshi Harada
pmc-13199936.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The oxygen environment within malignant solid tumors is highly heterogeneous, with anoxic regions arising where oxygen supply is insufficient. It is known that oxygen depletion is one of the most influential factors that confer radioresistance on cancer cells. The resistance under low oxygen conditions has been attributed to both hypoxia-inducible genes-dependent biological mechanisms and genes-independent chemical mechanisms resulting from reduced production of radiation-induced reactive oxygen species. However, the relative contributions of these mechanisms have remained unclear.

pmc-13649846.title: Performance of porous carbons based on waste-printed paper on the CO2 capture by temperature swing adsorption
pmc-13649846.creator: Yanier Sánchez-Hechavarría, Jorge Arce-Castro, João Pedro Santos Alves, Tamille Alves Souza, Mauricio Brandão dos Santos, Fernanda Teixeira Cruz, Raildo Alves Fiuza Junior, Karen Valverde Pontes, Artur José Santos Mascarenhas
pmc-13649846.description: The development of low-cost and sustainable adsorbents is crucial for reducing CO2 emissions associated with climate change. In this context, waste-derived porous carbons have emerged as promising materials for adsorption applications. This work evaluates the CO2 adsorption performance of porous carbons derived from printed paper waste using temperature swing adsorption (TSA).
